infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Apex Fitness uses your location to record the route, distance, pace and elevation of the activity you are tracking.
infoPlist.NSLocationAlwaysAndWhenInUseUsageDescrip: Apex Fitness records your route for the whole activity, including while the screen is off or another app is open. Without "Always" access, a run or ride stops being recorded the moment you leave the app.
infoPlist.NSMotionUsageDescription: Apex Fitness reads motion activity to tell walking, running and cycling apart, and to pause your recording automatically when you stop moving. This is also what lets the app turn GPS off while you are stationary, which is most of its battery saving.
